title.value: Continuous Coordination As a Realistic Scenario for Lifelong Learning
title.justification: It is clearly stated at the beginning of the paper, both in the title itself and repeatedly throughout the introduction and abstract.
title.quote: Continuous Coordination As a Realistic Scenario for Lifelong Learning

analysis.description: The paper aims to introduce a multi-agent lifelong learning testbed named Lifelong Hanabi, which supports both zero-shot and few-shot settings. This testbed is based on the Hanabi game, providing a challenging scenario for lifelong reinforcement learning (RL). The research evaluates various multi-agent RL (MARL) methods and benchmarks state-of-the-art lifelong learning algorithms under limited memory and computational constraints. It presents a continual learning paradigm to go beyond centralized training often used in MARL.

type.justification: The paper evaluates several recent MARL methods and benchmarks state-of-the-art LLL algorithms, which shows it involves experimentation and analysis of empirical data.
type.quote: We evaluate several recent MARL methods, and benchmark state-of-the-art LLL algorithms in limited memory and computation regimes to shed light on their strengths and weaknesses.
